CONNGUARD.Settings.Interval.Name: Measurement interval (seconds)
CONNGUARD.Settings.Interval.Hint: How often each client measures its own latency against the server.
CONNGUARD.Settings.Hide.Name: Hide latency in the player list
CONNGUARD.Settings.Micro.Name: Compact mode (+ / - instead of ms value)
CONNGUARD.Settings.DiagTooltip.Name: Show jitter and estimated loss in tooltip
CONNGUARD.Settings.DiagTooltip.Hint: When disabled, the tooltip only shows the ms value.
CONNGUARD.Settings.AutoReconnect.Name: More aggressive auto-reconnect
CONNGUARD.Settings.AutoReconnect.Hint: Shortens the delay between reconnection attempts and forces a new attempt as soon as the network or tab become active again.
CONNGUARD.Settings.ReconnectMaxDelay.Hin: Ceiling of the exponential reconnection backoff.
CONNGUARD.Settings.HistorySize.Name: How many drops to keep in history
Average RTT above this value for consecutive cycles triggers a degradation alert.
CONNGUARD.Settings.DegradationCycles.Hin: How many consecutive cycles above the threshold before triggering an alert.
CONNGUARD.Settings.CustomStun.Name: Custom STUN/TURN servers
CONNGUARD.Settings.CustomStun.Hint: Comma-separated list (e.g. stun:host:port,turn:host:port). Empty uses the default list.
CONNGUARD.Settings.TurnCredentials.Name: TURN credentials
CONNGUARD.Settings.TurnCredentials.Hint: Credentials in user:password format. GM only.
CONNGUARD.Menu.GmPanel.Name: Diagnostics Panel (GM)
CONNGUARD.Menu.GmPanel.Label: Open panel
CONNGUARD.Menu.GmPanel.Hint: Latency, jitter, estimated loss, drop history and degradation alerts for every user.
CONNGUARD.Menu.WebRtc.Name: Voice/Video Server Advisor
CONNGUARD.Menu.WebRtc.Label: Test servers
CONNGUARD.Menu.WebRtc.Hint: Benchmarks STUN servers and automatically applies the fastest one to WebRTC config.
CONNGUARD.Badge.NoResponseTitle: No response for several measurement cycles
CONNGUARD.Banner.Disconnected: Lost connection to the server ({reason}). Trying to reconnect...
CONNGUARD.Notif.Reconnected: Reconnected to the server (was down for {seconds}s).
CONNGUARD.Notif.WebRtcAutoFailed: Could not apply automatically. Copy the server manually.
CONNGUARD.Panel.JournalError: Error creating journal. Check the console.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.Explanation: Measuring response time of public STUN servers from your browser. Faster servers here tend to help WebRTC (voice/video) connect faster and with fewer NAT failures.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.HowTo: To use: Configure Game → Audio/Video → Server tab → paste the fastest server URL into the custom STUN/TURN server field.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.TurnNote: This only benchmarks STUN servers (finding a path). Free public TURN servers barely exist — if your table needs one (very restrictive networks/CGNAT), the real option is hosting your own coturn or paying for a TURN service.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.AutoApplied: Best STUN server applied automatically to WebRTC configuration.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.CopyFailed: Could not copy automatically — copy the value manually from the table.
CONNGUARD.WebRtc.NoneAvailable: No server responded in time. Try again.
CONNGUARD.Menu.DependenciesNotReady: Module dependencies not yet initialized. Wait for full loading.
